intro.text: A sport, and King Eventeo of Teod's favourite.
A sport invented in Svorden and still played in several nations, though Svorden has been annexed by the Fjordell Empire. It is King Eventeo of Teod's favourite.

description.text: When Sarene was a girl, Eventeo nicknamed her "leky stick" because she was as tall and thin as the pole that marks the goal line.
Eventeo tells Raoden where the nickname comes from, and Raoden, delighted, uses it to tease Sarene all the time.
